tci.title: Flag of the Turks and Caicos Islands

countryData.name: Turks and Caicos Islands
countryData.officialName: Turks and Caicos Islands (British Overseas Territory)

colors.note: British Blue Ensign; the Caribbean Sea.
The conch shell and lobster in the coat of arms.

desc:
- A Blue Ensign with the coat of arms of the Turks and Caicos Islands featuring a conch shell, spiny lobster, and Turk's-head cactus
- These elements represent the islands' marine life and distinctive flora
- **Construction:** a Blue Ensign (1:2) with the Union Flag in the upper-hoist canton. The shield (conch, lobster, cactus) appears in the fly half
trivia:
- The Turks and Caicos Islands use the Union Jack
- Reflecting their status as a British Overseas Territory
- The islands are known for beaches and tourism
